Name: Therapist NPC
Author: Endwyr
Description:
== New NPC ==
Adds a Therapist to the Valley, named Grey.

== Work & Housing ==
Grey lives in the Forest, next to Marnie's, on the road to Town.
Grey has an office in his home, and an office in the Hospital.

== (Day of Month) Therapy Schedule ==
(1) Caroline. Marnie
(Fall 2) Haley.
(3) Couples Therapy, Robin & Demetrius.
(Summer 3) Emily.
(4) Alex (& Dusty). Kent.
(If you have the DustyNPC Mod, Dusty will follow Alex to Therapy)
(5) Jodi.
(7) Penny.
(9) AA* Pam & Shane & Penny.
(10) Pierre.
(14) Family Therapy, Robin & Demetrius & Sebastian.
(18) Alex (& Dusty). Kent. Clint.
(22) Family Therapy, Caroline & Abigail & Pierre.
(Winter 22) Elliot.
(23) AA* Pam & Shane & Marnie.
* = AA is in the Hospital, but moves to the Community Center when rebuilt.

== Therapy Triggers ==
~Abigail joins Family Therapy after Caroline's 6 Heart Event.
~Alex attends after 8 Heart Event.
~Demetrius attends after his 6 Heart Event.
~Jodi attends after 2 Hearts total.
~Kent attends after his 3 Heart Event.
~Robin attends after Demetrius 6 Heart Event.
~Shane attends Group after his 6 Heart Event.
~Pam attends Group after Home Upgrade & 9 Heart Event.
~Penny attends Group after Pam invites her (See: Bus Stop Pam & Penny Therapy Event).
~Marnie attends Group after Community Center Complete, & both Shane's 6 Heart & 7 Heart Events.

== Therapy Events ==
~Pam & Penny @ BusStop, after Community Center Complete & Pam attends Group (& 2 Hearts w/ Grey).
~After Shane attends AA, he works at Marnie's Ranch on Mondays and Tuesdays.
~Pam & Gus @ Saloon, after Pam & Penny Event (& 2 Hearts w/ Gus).
Teletherapy:
~Sebastian @ Sebastian's Room after 2 Heart Event & 3 Hearts w/ Grey.
~Maru @ Maru's House after 2 Heart Event & 3 Hearts w/ Grey.
~Sam @ Sam's House after 2 Heart Event & 3 Hearts w/ Sam.
~Haley & Emily Family Therapy @ their House after both of their 2 Heart Events & 3 Hearts w/ Grey.


== Grey's Events ==
~Introduction Cutscene when entering the Forest for the first time.
~2 Heart Cutscene at the Hospital.

﻿== 1.6 ==
Fully Compatible!

== FAQ ==

Are they romanceable?
No, Grey is happily single at this time.

Is it compatible with X mod?
Unsure, compatibility has not been tested. There is an SVE patch by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83651033]VulbyAlt[/url] .

Why doesn't Grey attend festivals?
He attends the Feast of the Winter Star, but he avoids other festivals to avoid double relationships.

That being said, there are boundaries to my competence and if anything looks or reads weird/inappropriate, let me know ASAP so I can work on adapting it.
